summary: Expanded the public-company universe around frozen potato products and signature QSR sides. The strongest direct public exposure is Lamb Weston as a frozen potato processor with disclosed McDonald's concentration. Underfollowed second-order lanes include food-processing equipment used in industrial fry and potato-specialty production, temperature-controlled logistics required for frozen-food distribution, and foodservice packaging tied to fries, takeout, and delivery. No buy/sell view is implied.
